The Respondents are distribution licensees, power departments and transmission licensees, which are procuring transmission services from the Petitioner, mainly beneficiaries of Northern Region. 5. The Petitioner has served the petition on the Respondents and notice regarding filing of this petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003. No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers. None of the Respondents have filed their reply in the matter. 6. The hearing in this matter was held on 9.7.2021 through video conference and the order was reserved. 7. This order is issued considering the submissions made by the Petitioner in the petition vide affidavit dated 6.1.2020 and Petitioner’s affidavit dated 12.2.2021 filed in compliance of Technical Validation letter. 8. Having heard the representatives of the Petitioner and after perusal of the materials on record, we proceed to dispose of the petition.
